profile_semantics.native_velocity_boundary: v16_native_far_field_uBC: +x freestream velocity 1 m/s; other normal components zero
profile_semantics.pressure_boundary: WaterLily projection pressure; no per-patch freestreamPressure input
profile_semantics.ground_model: moving planar half-space at z=0 with +x wall velocity 1 m/s
profile_semantics.force_integration_body: canonical v16 candidate GridSDF only; exclude auxiliary moving-ground half-space

measurement.force_sample_policy: sample every 8 solver steps and also sample the first step at or beyond tU/L=120 to bracket the exact measurement window
measurement.primary_force_metric: trapezoidal physical-time-weighted mean over exact [80,120] endpoints, with linear interpolation from bracketing raw force samples
measurement.force_integration_body: canonical v16 candidate GridSDF only; exclude the auxiliary moving-ground half-space
measurement.vram_gate: record peak and total; require 0 < peak < total

artifacts_per_case: raw force CSV with total, pressure, and viscous x/y/z components
case summary with mapped grid, physical forces, coefficients, both half-window diagnostics, runtime, and VRAM
input SDF hashes, CPU-side margin, GPU round-trip hash, and backend fingerprint

response_analysis.report_resolution_delta: flow_24 to flow_32 for time-weighted drag and downforce in N and relative terms
response_analysis.report_domain_delta: flow_16 to domain_xplus3p5_16 for time-weighted drag and downforce in N and relative terms
response_analysis.relative_delta_definition: abs(a-b)/max(abs(a),abs(b)); when both values are zero report relative delta as not applicable and retain the absolute delta
response_analysis.followup_rule: If the absolute domain delta in either time-weighted force component in N is greater than or equal to its 24-to-32 resolution delta, register and run an extended-domain fine-grid case before centered FD.

evidence_scope.pass_claim: the registered v16 WaterLily finite-box resolution/domain sensitivity matrix completed and was independently recomputed
